reports.title: Classic Magic The Pole
reports.text:
Two men had a dream. One man had a personal goal of making the best crappie jighead for hollow body crappie tubes. The other man had a dream of winning the Crappie Classic, the Super Bowl of crappie fishing.
The Dreamers David Summer was a schoolteacher in northwestern Tennessee when he worked on a jighead that would hold a tube jig better than other heads on the market. A combination of good holding ability without tearing the jig resulted in a two-barbed collar with barbs on opposite sides. It worked. Good holding power was only a part of his design. He wanted a pill-shaped head to get down quickly and come through limbs a little better than a ball head jig. A good paint job and prism…
